_about: English phrases. 'spoken' entries can be replaced by recordings named ui.<name> (see audio-scripts/). Keep the same keys in bn.json.

spoken.type_number: Type a number, then press Enter.
spoken.lesson_complete: Lesson complete. Well done! Press Alt M for the lesson list.
spoken.no_question: There is no question here. Read the text with the arrow keys.
spoken.help_list: Up and down arrows choose a lesson. Page Down and Page Up jump to the next or previous section. Enter opens the lesson. Alt B changes the language.
spoken.help_text: Left and right arrows read the text. Space plays all of it, and pauses. Alt L reads by letter, Alt W by word, Alt S by sentence. Alt T then A turns audio word mode on or off. Enter goes to the task. R repeats the question. Control Up and Control Down move between the question, the matrix and the answer. Alt P changes the view of the matrix. Alt N skips. Alt M goes back to the lesson list.
spoken.help_matrix: Arrow keys move. Up is forward, down is back. Enter gives your answer. R repeats the question. Space tells where you are, when allowed. Control Up and Control Down move between the question, the matrix and the answer.
spoken.help_answer: Type a number and press Enter. Control Up and Control Down move between the question, the matrix and the answer.
spoken.choose: Choose an answer. Up and down arrows read the answers. Enter, or the number key, picks one.
spoken.help_choice: Up and down arrows read the answers. Press Enter, or press 1, 2, 3 or 4, to choose. R repeats the question. Control Up and Control Down move between the question, the matrix and the answer.
spoken.help_matrix_contents: Arrow keys move. Space tells what is in this cell. Enter gives your answer. R repeats the question. Control Up and Control Down move between the question, the matrix and the answer.
spoken.start_row_question: Which row did you start in?
spoken.start_column_question: Which column did you start in?
spoken.help_matrix_diagonal: Arrow keys move. Diagonal steps: E or Page Up is forward-right, Q or Home is forward-left, C or Page Down is back-right, Z or End is back-left. On a number pad use 9, 7, 3 and 1. Enter gives your answer. R repeats the question. Control Up and Control Down move between the question, the matrix and the answer.
spoken.help_matrix_reader: Arrow keys move. Down goes to the next row, up goes to the row before. Enter gives your answer. R repeats the question. Space tells where you are, when allowed. Control Up and Control Down move between the question, the matrix and the answer.
spoken.help_matrix_diagonal_reader: Arrow keys move. Diagonal steps: C or Page Down is down-right, Z or End is down-left, E or Page Up is up-right, Q or Home is up-left. On a number pad use 3, 1, 9 and 7. Enter gives your answer. R repeats the question. Control Up and Control Down move between the question, the matrix and the answer.
spoken.pov_reader: Reader's view. Row 1 is at the top. The down arrow goes to the next row.
spoken.pov_screen: Screen view. Row 1 is at the bottom. The up arrow goes to the next row.

screen.home_hint: ↑ ↓ choose a lesson · PgDn PgUp sections · Enter open · Alt+B language · Alt+H help
screen.lesson_hint: Ctrl+↓ Ctrl+↑: text ↔ matrix ↔ answer · R question · Alt+P view · Alt+N skip · Alt+M lessons · Alt+H help
screen.no_voice: This computer has no {language} voice. Recorded clips will be used where they exist; other phrases may be silent.

templates.find_cell_prompt: Find the {item}. It is in the cell at row {row}, column {col}. Move to it and press Enter.
templates.matrix_size_prompt: How big is this matrix? Explore it with the arrow keys. Then type the number of rows and press Enter, and type the number of columns and press Enter.
templates.relative_move_prompt: {moves}. Where are you now? Move there and press Enter.

templates.move_right_many: move {n} steps right along the row
templates.move_left_one: move 1 step left along the row
templates.move_left_many: move {n} steps left along the row

templates.find_own_prompt: You are somewhere in a {rows} by {cols} matrix. No cell speaks. Walk to the edges and count your steps to find the cell where you started. Then type its row and press Enter, and type its column and press Enter.
